text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for traffic calming, specifically speed humps on College View Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway, to address residents' concerns regarding vehicle speeds. Our assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the traffic calming policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, traffic calming should not be installed on the subject section of College View Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the Acting Director of Traffic Management, Transportation Services, to request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders on College View Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway, to determine whether residents support the installation of traffic calming, in accordance with the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the poll, the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on College View Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. 421G-3215', dated December 2018, attached to the report (December 4, 2018) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
